task: Prepare the untouched Poly Haven Drawer Cabinet glTF for physics, retaining its actual five source meshes. Anchor the cabinet and keep the lower three drawers closed. Make the uppermost component drawer_cabinet_drawer_01 a physically constrained drawer that opens along positive world Z at least0.20m, returns within0.02m of its original closed pose, and retains a free0.5kg payload under gravity. The motion must result from force-limited dynamics, not pose animation. Independent evaluation imports your actual saved USD. Preserve source geometry, provide valid mass/inertia and traversable collision approximations, and report limitations honestly. The original five node names are drawer_cabinet, drawer_cabinet_drawer_01, drawer_cabinet_drawer_02, drawer_cabinet_drawer_03, drawer_cabinet_drawer_04.

public_acceptance.backend: ovphysx 0.4.13 direct USD import; CPU PhysX on the assigned Horde node

controller.kind: bounded external world-force PD with smooth half-cosine target ramps

public_acceptance.pass_rule: All structural/source checks and all five independently simulated seeds pass; no averaging across failed seeds.
evaluator_interventions: flatten submitted USD into an immutable evaluation copy
reject time-sampled physics/geometry rather than play animation
remove authored joint drives and reject extra dynamic controllers
set gravity and solver iteration counts consistently
enable contact reporting without changing submitted collider geometry or collision filtering
add independently authored 0.5kg payload; never attach it to drawer
apply only bounded external drawer force; never write body poses or velocities during stepping
public_acceptance.uncertainty: Mass, inertia, friction and force actuation are documented simulation abstractions. Passing does not validate physical furniture or robot manipulation.
